description: Gaia passbands: the (E)DR3 broad-band passbands (G, Gbp, Grp) and the DR3 Radial Velocity Spectrometer band (Grvs), plus the bright and faint BP passbands (Gbp_bright for G < 10.87, Gbp_faint for G > 10.87) from Maíz Apellániz & Weiler's (2018) revision of the Gaia DR2 passbands.
short_description: Gaia DR3 passbands + BP bright/faint (Maíz Apellániz & Weiler 2018)
facility_description: Gaia is a European Space Agency astrometric, photometric and spectroscopic space observatory operating at the Sun-Earth L2 Lagrange point.
notes: G, Gbp and Grp are the Gaia (E)DR3 passbands and Grvs is the Gaia DR3 RVS passband: each curve's data rows are identical to SVO's GAIA/GAIA3 record of the same band (SVO description 'GAIA <band> filter, DR3'; SVO profile reference https://www.cosmos.esa.int/web/gaia/edr3-passbands for G, Gbp and Grp, and https://www.cosmos.esa.int/web/gaia/dr3-passbands for Grvs). They are not the Maíz Apellániz & Weiler (2018) curves. Gbp_bright and Gbp_faint are Maíz Apellániz & Weiler's (2018, A&A 619, A180) revision of the Gaia DR2 BP passband, which has one BP passband for bright stars (G < 10.87) and one for faint stars (G > 10.87); their data rows are identical to SVO's GAIA/Gaia2m.Gbp_bright and GAIA/Gaia2m.Gbp_faint. The curves were compared with SVO captures of 2026-10-27. Pre-launch nominal passbands are described in Jordi et al. (2010). DetectorType (photon) is SVO's for all six bands and is left unchanged.
